table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	DocRowId=DocRowId,
	DocumentCode=DocumentCode,   
	DocumentType=DocumentType,   
	GCode = GCode,
	DocCatCode=DocCatCode,
	Category = Category,
	PartyType=PartyType,   
	PartyCode=PartyCode,
	PartyName = PartyName,
	UserCode=UserCode,   
	Amount=Amount, 
	Remarks=Remarks,   
	Printed=Printed,   
	Date=Date,
	MachineName=MachineName
FROM
	(SELECT
		DocRowId,
		DocumentCode,   
		DocumentType,   
		GCode = CASE WHEN DocumentType IN ('SC','ST') THEN (SELECT MIN(D.GCode) FROM SaleDetail D WHERE D.SaleInvCode=ActivityMonitor.DocumentCode) ELSE -1 END,
		DocCatCode,
		Category = Category,
		PartyType,   
		PartyCode,
		PartyName = 
			CASE 
				WHEN PartyType='G' THEN (SELECT Godown.Name FROM Godown WHERE Godown.GCode = ActivityMonitor.PartyCode) 
				WHEN PartyType='P' THEN (SELECT SalesMan.Name FROM SalesMan WHERE SalesMan.SalesManCode = ActivityMonitor.PartyCode) 
				WHEN PartyType IN ('C','S','A') THEN (SELECT A.Name FROM Accounts A WHERE A.AccCode = PartyCode)
			ELSE '' END,
		UserCode,   
		Amount, 
		Remarks,   
		Printed,   
		Date,
		MachineName
	FROM ActivityMonitor  
	WHERE DocumentType IN (:as_doctype) AND 
		Date >= CASE :ai_min WHEN -1 THEN :ad_startdate ELSE DATEADD(mi, -1 * :ai_min, GETDATE()) END AND Date <= GETDATE() AND
		UserCode IN 
			(SELECT DISTINCT U.usercode
			FROM  Users U, UserGroups UG, GroupAllowedGroups GAG
			WHERE U.UserCode = UG.UserCode And UG.GroupCode = GAG.AllowedGroupCode And 
				GAG.Module IN (1,2)
			UNION
			SELECT U.Usercode
			FROM     Users U, UserGroups UG
			WHERE    U.usercode = UG.usercode And UG.GroupCode = :ai_groupcode) AND
		EXISTS 
			(SELECT DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AllowedGroupsInSalesList') 
						WHERE DBO.Fn_GetPreference('AllowedGroupsInSalesList') = 'Y')) ActivityMonitor
WHERE 
	GCode IN (SELECT DISTINCT GAD.GCode FROM GroupAllowedGodown GAD WHERE GAD.GroupCode=:ai_groupcode and GAD.Module in (1,2) UNION SELECT -1 ) 
		
ORDER BY Date DESC
